cases.prompt: 把 HTML 圖表套用全球藍。2026 Q2，各通路金額百萬元：A=120、B=88、C=54、D=38；來源：示意資料。可重排與改標題。

must_do: use Focus for the single-period comparison
deliver SVG with matching data and reproducible generator
retain period unit source and all four values
must_not_do: claim a trend from one period
flatten surrounding text into an image
required_validation: compare output values and labels with source

cases.prompt: 這份 Word 只有圖表 PNG、沒有原始資料，幫我套全球藍。

must_do: preserve the original raster chart
style editable surrounding document content
identify missing chart source data
must_not_do: estimate values from pixels
claim raster-wrapped SVG is a vector reconstruction
stop all independent formatting work

cases.prompt: Excel 圖表套用全球藍，但修改儲存格後必須自動更新。

must_do: preserve native data and formulas
use a supported native chart for automatic updates
explain any styling limitations
must_not_do: promise an embedded SVG will update with edited cells

cases.prompt: 重排 Word 報告並把兩張圖換成全球藍 SVG。原生段落與表格都需要保留。

must_do: scope image replacement to the intended nodes
preserve paragraph and table content
check actual table header contrast
required_validation: compare source and output content inventories
inspect pagination and image aspect ratios

cases.prompt: 已套用全球藍的 PPTX 可以解析 ZIP，但這裡沒有 PowerPoint。請交付。

must_do: report structural checks separately from rendering
identify unverified target application rendering
must_not_do: claim PowerPoint visual acceptance
claim Windows or Office Web compatibility

cases.prompt: 這張全球藍月度堆疊圖有六個固定通路，全部保留；不要自行歸成其他。

must_do: retain all six categories and values
choose small multiples tables or split charts with direct labels
must_not_do: collapse categories into Other without authorization
use action orange as a sixth series

cases.prompt: 把四個既有風險等級的矩陣改為全球藍，其中一格是0，另一格缺值。

must_do: preserve the original four ordered levels
use an ordered blue ramp
distinguish zero from missing data
must_not_do: invent a fifth data level to fill the palette
turn missing data into zero

cases.prompt: 把 960×420 純圖與 16:9 PPTX 同時改全球藍。

must_do: preserve the standalone chart aspect ratio
convert design pixels to actual slide dimensions
keep sources and data labels readable
must_not_do: stretch the chart to fill the slide
apply slide font floors mechanically to the standalone chart

cases.prompt: 用全球藍規範套 PPTX，舊 potx 用 Noto 字型，舊圖表文件写 #27327B。

must_do: use the verified role colors and typography from the bundled design snapshot
treat the old Office container as non-authoritative for font roles
must_not_do: claim local v2.5.0 tokens equal the complete live v2.5.1 system

cases.prompt: 只修改全球藍網站的設計 tokens，沒有文件要改。

must_do: route design-system maintenance outside this adaptation skill
must_not_do: apply document restyling workflow
claim the application proposal is approved CIS

cases.prompt: 把區域營業利益 HTML 報告套用全球藍，另附可單独使用的 SVG。2026 Q2，百萬元：北區75、中區0、南區-12、海外未提供。註：海外尚未回報，不含稅項調整。來源：內部示意資料。

must_do: retain zero negative and missing values distinctly
include period unit source and interpretive notes in the standalone SVG
use Focus blue and gray for ordinary comparison
must_not_do: infer risk status from a negative sign alone
rely only on the containing HTML for source context
required_validation: inspect standalone SVG separately from the report

cases.prompt: 把報告中的資料做成最適合的全球藍圖表，不要問我選哪種。2026 Q2 期初保單 100 件，新增 30、解約 -12、失效 -3，期末 115 件；來源：營運月報。

must_do: select waterfall because the values are an additive bridge from opening to closing
state the selection and a short reason
preserve all signed changes period unit and source
must_not_do: ask the user to choose a chart
use a Pareto chart merely because there are multiple causes

cases.prompt: 通路甲與乙的商品 A/B/C 銷售額分別為 70/20/10 與 20/30/50。問題是各通路的商品組成差在哪裡；請自動選圖。

must_do: select 100% stacked bars because the question is composition by channel
retain all amounts and label the denominator
must_not_do: use Marimekko when total channel size is not part of the question
present equal-width bars as market-size comparison

cases.prompt: 通路甲與乙的商品 A/B/C 銷售額分別為 700/200/100 與 20/30/50。問題是誰的市場較大且各自賣什麼；請自動選圖。

must_do: select Marimekko because both total market size and internal composition matter
preserve a common area denominator
must_not_do: use equal-width 100% stacked bars as the sole answer

cases.prompt: 有客訴原因可複選：價格 40、等待 35、服務 30。請做帕累托圖並說前三項累計占比。

must_do: identify that overlapping reasons invalidate a cumulative share of cases
use a ranked comparison or table without a misleading cumulative case share
must_not_do: claim the Pareto cumulative percentage is a share of unique cases

cases.prompt: 每月收到申請 100、審核 80、完成 90；這三個數是不同月份彙總。請做漏斗圖。

must_do: identify that the stages are not the same cohort and cannot support a funnel
recommend a period-by-stage table or trend without inventing conversion rates
must_not_do: silently force the completed count below review count

cases.prompt: 自動選圖呈現 12 個固定產品在 6 個月的銷售；每個產品都要保留並可跨月追蹤。

must_do: use small multiples split charts or a table instead of one unreadable categorical chart
retain all 12 products and values
must_not_do: merge products into Other without authorization
assign more than four fixed categorical colors in one chart

cases.prompt: 有四個門市同口徑的改善前與改善後等候分鐘數；請用啞鈴圖，不要自動換圖。

must_do: honor dumbbell because paired before-after observations are eligible
show each matched pair and its difference
must_not_do: replace the requested appropriate chart with a ranking chart

cases.prompt: 用全球藍自動選圖比較 A、B、C 部門處理天數的分布。我只有平均天數 4.2、5.1、3.8，沒有逐筆資料或分位數。

must_do: explain that means alone cannot show distributions
render a comparison of provided means or a table and state the missing distribution data
must_not_do: invent quartiles whiskers or outliers
present a box plot from means alone

cases.prompt: 將含原生圖表與內嵌工作簿的 PPTX 套用全球藍。簡報問題是比較不同規模通路的相對成長，原圖是絕對量長條。請用原數據思考新圖並放回簡報，保留附錄表格與備忘稿。

must_do: extract original series and preserve baseline values; evaluate indexed comparison with common positive base period
deliver a modified document copy with the new chart embedded
retain original observations unit period source and surrounding editable content
provide data and reproducible generator alongside SVG
include supported conclusion reading explanation and directly readable values
must_not_do: stop after delivering standalone SVGs
use illustrative gallery data instead of source values
rename benchmark or units to fit a chart
required_validation: compare before and after data and surrounding content
inspect chart at actual document size or disclose visual verification limits

cases.prompt: 將 Word 報告套用全球藍並重新選圖。原圖是實際值 PNG，下方表格提供三項實際值及目標。請保留正文、圖說、資料表與頁首，交付修改後文件。

must_do: use source table for rebuilding the chart instead of estimating PNG values; compare actual and declared targets
deliver a modified document copy with the new chart embedded
retain original observations unit period source and surrounding editable content
provide data and reproducible generator alongside SVG
include supported conclusion reading explanation and directly readable values
must_not_do: stop after delivering standalone SVGs
use illustrative gallery data instead of source values
rename benchmark or units to fit a chart
required_validation: compare before and after data and surrounding content
inspect chart at actual document size or disclose visual verification limits

cases.prompt: 將既有 HTML 市場報告改用全球藍。報告要同時比較規模和組成；原圖只呈现總量，資料表有各通路互斥商品金額。保留導覽錨點與資料表。

must_do: use original table values to select scale-and-composition encoding and insert it in the original chart container
deliver a modified document copy with the new chart embedded
retain original observations unit period source and surrounding editable content
provide data and reproducible generator alongside SVG
include supported conclusion reading explanation and directly readable values
must_not_do: stop after delivering standalone SVGs
use illustrative gallery data instead of source values
rename benchmark or units to fit a chart
required_validation: compare before and after data and surrounding content
inspect chart at actual document size or disclose visual verification limits
